name: Kyankyan
source:
A Kyankyan type monster girl. Kyankyans are bunny girls that are common throughout Alicesoft games. This Kyankyan can be found playing in the forest and is the first monster girl [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] is likely to find. Although she appears weak and cannot attack enemies herself she's a valuable ally for Leo to find. She loves carrots, perhaps too much.

This Kyankyan loves to play and have sex and although she knows that Leo's semen is poison she constantly begs him to have sex with her and asks him to ejaculate inside her anyway.
